tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dus 'khor sdom chen gyi thig tshon gsal

byed bzhugs/ na mo gu ru kā la tsakrā ya/ dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'i sa gzhi la/ /nya steng tshangs thig 'debs pa sogs/ /'debs tshul spyi dang mthun mod kyi/ /gzhan du tshangs zur zhes grags kyang/ /'di la bzhi char tshangs thig yin/ /de la rtse mo brgyad yod do/ /thig bzhi nya dang 'phrad mtshams ni/ /brgyad nas bya rjes btsal ba dang*/ thig bzhi rtse mo brgyad btab pa/ /'di la mtshams thig ces bya'o/ dkyil 'khor 'di la zur med pas/ /zur thig tha snyad 'dir mi bzhed/ / thig gi rtse mo bcu drug ni/ /sgo brgyad mtshams brgyad rnams kyi yin/ /sgo mtshams bcu drug zhes su brjod/ kun gyi dkyus la khru brgyad do/ /cha chen gcig la cha chung drug la sogs/ /dus 'khor lugs kyi brda' chad shes par bya/ /rtsa thig gru bzhi cha chen mtho gang ste/ /de tshe cha chung re la sor gnyis 'byung*/ /cha chung phyed pa sor gang yin par 'dod/ /de yi rigs pa che chung gzhan la'ang sbyor/ /shar nub tshangs thig steng du mtho gang ba'i/ /shing bus bzhal nas dkar rtags brgyad brgyad btab/ /de steng dbus nas brtsams te bskor thig brgyad/ /bzhi pa rtsa thig drug pa mda' yab thig /dang po gnyis pa gsum pa bzhi pa rnams/ /phyed phyed bgos pas cha chen phyed pa brgyad/ /brgyad po re re'i nang du'ang sum cha dbye/ /phye ba'i sum cha kun yang phyed gshegs bgos/ /de ltar rtsa thig nang gi phyogs re rer/ /cha chung phyed pa bzhi bcu zhe brgyad yod/ /phyogs gnyis sdoms pas dgu bcu drug ces gsungs/ /dngos su skor thig bdun gsum nyi shu gcig /mda' thig tshun gyi skor thig rlon pas mnon/ /mtshams thig brgyad dang cha chen bzhi lnga drug /nor so spong phyir kha dog me 'dras gnon/ /mtshon sa'i thig gi nang du tshangs thig ni/ /g.yas g.yon cha chung re re bcal ba na/ /dkar rtags btab ste skam thig drang bar bya/ /de dang tshangs zur bar kyi sum gnyis nang*/

/sum cha phyi ru las pa'i mtshams nas ni// nang nas phyi ru sum cha'i tshad gzhal bar/ /skam thig la reg 'khor lo'i brang ngos bri/ /de nas skor thig bar gyi tshangs thig la/ /reg pa'i rtsibs kyi rtse mo rnon por bya/ /sdom pa chung ba sogs dang 'di mi 'dra/ /'di ni bgegs 'joms mtshon cha'i 'khor lor 'dod/ /dbus kyi pad 'dab gnas kyi bcu drug thig /re re'i bar yang kha dog gzhan gyis bcad/ /chung na de tsam gyis chog rgya che na/ /'dab thig pad shun spyi dang mthun par bya/ /rtsig pa'i nang la khru bzhi yod gyur na/ /dbus kyi pad+ma mtho gang tshad du 'gyur/ /rtsa thig tshangs thig 'phrad mtshams nas/ /g.yas g.yon cha chen lnga pa yi/ /dbus su drang por ri mo bya/ /sgo tshad gnyis su rtags 'debs te/ /de nas steng du sgo tshad lnga/ /steng gi logs su sgo tshad gnyis/ /bya rjes btsal nas thig gdab bo/ /tshangs thig rtse mo brgyad kyang ring du 'dren/ /tshangs thig g.yas g.yon sdoms pa'i cha chen bzhi/ /logs su drug drug bgos pas nyer bzhi 'byung*/ /dbus nas phyi ngos cha chen lnga yod pa'i/ /dang po'i phyi nang gnyis ni bzhi cha gdab/ /gsum pa'i nang du gsum cha gdab par bya/ /de yang gnyis su bgo zhing bzhi pa yi/ /phyi nang gnyis su bzhi cha re re gdab/ /gnyis po de yang phyed phyed bgo bar bya/ /lnga pa gsum du bgos shing bar ma la/ /nang gi ngos su rang gi bzhi cha gdab/ /'di'i 'phreng thig dang po rtsa thig dod/ /de nas phyi ru thig ni bcu drug yod/ /de ltar sgo dang rta babs grub pa yin/ /tshangs pa'i thig las logs su gsum pa'i thig /rtsa thig phyi ngos bzhi pa'i bar du drangs/ /de nas logs su dgu pa'i bar du ste/ /dgu pa de yang steng du lnga pa'i bar/ /bzhi lnga bar du steng du gsum pa la/ /reg pa'i thig gi nang mtha' gnyis par reg /phyi ma rtse nas logs su bcu gnyis pa/ /ngos su phyogs dang drag po nyi ma rnams/

/steng du lnga pa'i thig la reg pa'o/ /lnga pa g.yas g.yon bcu gnyis bar du ste/ /lnga pa'i phyi ru rta babs rnams kyi thig /tshangs pa'i thig gi g.yas dang g.yon ngos su/ /bcu gnyis brgyad dgu slar yang dgu dang drug /phyed bcas bdun pa zung dang bu ka mtshams/ /ro dang rig byed bse ru dkyus su'o/ /gdung bzhi myos srung gsum dang bum pa'i sne/ /rang rang thig gi sne nas 'og tu bcad/ /gnyis gsum bar du tshangs las gnyis pa dang*/ /me ri klu'i steng du bcas par bya/ /lnga drug bar du gzugs mig mtshams dang mig /mda' ro'i bar du cha chung bzhi cha gcod/ / de bzhin ngos kyi drug pa'i steng nas drangs/ /brgyad dgu'i bar du gcig dang gzugs mig bar/ /gsum bzhi'i bar dang bzhi par rlon thig gdab/ /bcu gcig thig ni lnga steng bcu par sbrel/ /sgo khang brgyad po'i phan tshun bar bar du// cha chen bzhi par phyi nang bzhi cha re/ /lnga pa phyed gshags de yi phyi ma'ang dbye/ / tshangs thig mtha' ni myos srung steng ma'i thig /de steng khor yug dang po'i nang thig bskor/ /de nas sgo tshad phyed gcig gzugs zla phyed/ /ri bong can gyi khor yug rim bzhin bskor/ /me yi phyed phyi rlung gi phyed nang mtshams/ /dur khrod khor yug tshad yin tshangs thig dang*/ /mtshams thig rnams kyi dbus nas tshon gyis bcad/ dur khrod bcu drug rnams kyi gnas su 'dod/ /nam mkha'i khor yug dbus su sum cha ni/ /rdo rje'i 'phreng ba'i gnas te ye shes kyi/ khor yug yin te thabs shes rgyas btab gnas/ /da ni tshon gyi rim pa ni/ pad+ma'i lte ba nag po/ de la bcad 'dra ba dmar po dang dkar po 'then/ steng du rdo rje sngon po bri/ 'dab ma rnams ljang khu/ phyogs mtshams su kha ṭ+wāṃ ga phyogs mdog bar bar du thod pa/ de'i phyi rol 'khor lo sngon po/ rtsibs bar ljang khu/ de'i phyi rol sa'i 'khor lo ser po/ rtsibs bar nag po/ chu'i 'khor lo dkar po/

rtsibs bar dmar po/ de'i phyi ru me 'khor lo dmar po/ rtsibs bar dkar po/ de'i phyi ru rlung gi 'khor lo nag po/ rtsibs bar ser po/ de'i phyi ru nam mkha'i 'khor lo ljang khu/ rtsibs bar sngon po/ 'khor lo drug po thabs cad kyi lte ba la rim pa gnyis yod pa'i phyi ma rtsibs skya mtshams de la/ phyag mtshan gyi phreng ba rnams 'bri ste/ ye shes la gri gug ser po la 'khor lo dkar po la pad+ma/ dmar po la rin po che/ nag po la ral gri 'phred rgyugs/ ljang khu la rdo rje 'phred rgyugs so/ /mtshon sa sgo dang bcas pa'i mdog ni/ shar sgo dang byang shar gyi sgo'i bar mtshams/ mtshams thig nas shar lho'i sgo dang*/ lho sgo'i bar gyi mtshams thig la thug gi bar nag po/ de nas nub dang bden bral gyi mtshams thig la thug gi bar dmar po/ de nas rlung dang byang gi bar gyi mtshams thig la thug gi bar dkar po/ de nas shar dang dbang ldan gyi mtshams thig la thug gi bar dmar po'o/ /phyogs bzhi'i sgo'i rta babs kyi steng du klu brgyad kyi gdan/ sgo khyud kyi nang brgyad dang stegs bu brgyad kyi steng du/ sgo mtshams bcu drug gi mi ro'i gdan la gri gug re'o/ /tshangs thig mtshams thig gi bar gyi dbus na dur khrod kyi mtshams yod sar chu ris phra mo gcod/ 'dir ri dwags 'khor lo sogs dang*/ dur khrod 'khor lo dang 'khor yug gi mtshan ma 'bri mi dgos/ lhag ma phal cher dus 'khor dang mtshungs shing*/ 'di nyid kyi mngon rtogs las kyang gsal lo/ /zhes dus 'khor sdom chen gyi thig tshon gsal byed 'di yang*/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// //zhus dgadage'o// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/ dus 'khor sdom chen gyi thig tshon gsal byed bzhugs/ -PAGE 396--PAGE 399--PAGE 395-
